name: infra
description: Service/host work: launchd jobs, tunnels, monitors, model seats. Owner-run mutations stay human-gated by design.

steps.title: Scope + risk: {title}
steps.body: What runs where, what breaks if it dies, rollback path. Mark host mutations OWNER-RUN (command printed, the owner executes).

steps.title: Implement: {title}
steps.body: Config/scripts committed. Never start/stop services from a tool lane; emit the exact command instead.

steps.title: Monitor it: {title}
steps.body: Register health check + status file. The estate registry must reflect the new service.

steps.title: Verify running: {title}
steps.body: Health check green twice across a restart. Attach probe output.
